newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare buys some assets with partner.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare buys some assets with partner.

text.p: RehabCare Group Inc said Tuesday it acquired, with one of its hospital clients, certain assets of a therapy provider in the hospital's service area.
RehabCare Group currently manages and staffs both the in-patient acute rehabilitation unit and out-patient departments of its joint venture partner.

The jointly acquired company provides physical, occupational and speech therapy services at three outpatient locations and on a contractual basis with school systems, home health agencies and nursing homes. The acquired company had annual revenues for 1996 of $1.7 million.

"The acquisition of these outpatient clinics will allow our hospital client to expand outpatient services further into their market area and capture additional revenue that would otherwise go to other providers," said James Usdan, president and chief executive officer in a statement. "Going forward, we will continue to pursue similar joint venture acquisitions with our many other hospital clients," he said.

RehabCare provides acute rehabilitation, subacute, outpatient, temporary and permanent therapist staffing services on a contract basis in conjunction with over 750 hospitals, nursing homes and contract therapy companies.
